notes.title: Exploration Mode Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588707/49d5e224784d9e14df735004e1d2480423b36542.png[/img]


New Game A = Action Mode

New Game B = Exploration Mode



Route A is the original game. Route B could be described as a mini metroidvania. Explore a new version of the Entangled Planet with remixed levels and boss encounters, with some unused assets added back in for a few new surprises. This update is free to everyone who already purchased the game, so don't expect too much new content. That said, this game mode is pretty much a completely new game. 

It is coming together nicely and should be releasing sometime this year or in 2026.

notes.title: The Tribulation Entanglement (Major Content Update)
notes.content:
The Tribulation Entanglement has received its FIRST major content update of 2023.
The first of multiple free game-expanding updates planned to release over the coming months.
This first update adds / fixes / rebalances / and rearranges much of the game's original content.

Updates are as follows:

[olist]
[*] Rebalanced bosses
[*] Rebalanced enemies
[*] Altered enemy placements
[*] Altered level layouts to improve playability
[*] Death traps have been altered or removed to reduce player frustration
[*] Health upgrade hearts are more visible now (they pulse to draw the player's attention)
[*] "Block breaking" segments have been trimmed to a minimum
[*] Various art assets have been added across the board
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/olist]

Note that this is only the first game changing update coming in 2023. The next should be larger, including new areas and enemies and music.... The goal is to double the game's length by the end of 2023. Every content update and expansion will be FREE of charge. NO paid DLC is planned.

Thank you so much for your patience and interest in our passion project!

notes.title: The Tribulation Entanglement - First Major Update
notes.content:
There have been various updates to the overall game, such as updates to the keyboard controls, difficulty changes, and bug fixes.

The major updates are as follows:

Keyboard inputs have been changed to a more standard setup:

The arrow keys are for movement and menu selections, Z is for jump, X is for attack, and C is sub attack. Enter is now the keyboard's "start / pause button." This should help resolve initial user confusion.

Next, the difficulty. I removed the "kill dragon to activate hard mode" thing. It seems many players have accidentally thrown themselves into hard mode and it negatively impacted their experience. I hope this change makes the exploration and difficulty more balanced and fun. Hard mode essentially deletes the health upgrades found throughout the world and removing these increased the difficulty, as well as reduced the fun of exploration. Hopefully this change is more satisfying and rewarding...


Finally, a major bug knocking the player out of bounds during iframes has been fixed. I haven't heard many reports of this, but I'm glad the bug has been fixed.

Lastly, these updates might affect save data. So it might require a start from scratch, but that can't be helped...

Thank you so much for your support and I hope you enjoy these changes!
